RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

Both you and the appointed candidate are men, making sex discrimination virtually impossible to substantiate. While an all-male panel may reflect organizational diversity deficits, it provides no evidence of bias between two male applicants. For a department head role, hiring committees routinely prioritize formal management training and broad leadership experience over advanced academic credentials like a PhD.

Raising the panel's gender composition would appear unfounded and could damage your professional reputation within the hospital network. Instead, send a polite follow-up regarding your request for feedback, focusing the discussion on how you can strengthen your executive leadership profile for future director-level opportunities.
